newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian insurance academy takes off next year.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian insurance academy takes off next year.

text.p: An academy to provide courses in insurance and train practitioners in the industry will be launched next January, an executive director of the Nigerian Reinsurance Corp (Nigeria Re) said on Monday.

"The academy will provide short term courses and programmes for practitioners and is in accordance with the mandate of the federal government in establishing Nigeria Re," Kunle Okenla told the News Agency of Nigeria in Enugu city, eastern Nigeria.
The University of Lagos currently offers full-time degree courses in insurance, a fast developing industry in Nigeria.
Okenla said the insurance academy was not designed to replace conventional degree programmes, but to train insurance practitioners.
